structured_output.summary: Implements Intl.Segmenter resolvedOptions, Segments.containing, the segment iterator's next, FindBoundary and CreateSegmentDataObject using ICU4X segmenters. Each follows the spec steps in order. The only observable operation is ToIntegerOrInfinity in containing, and it is in the right place. Boundaries come from ICU4X, with no tables of expected outputs and nothing keyed on test inputs. The `.expect()` calls in the constructor became not-implemented errors on paths that cannot be reached, which is acceptable. The grapheme segmenter ignores the locale because ICU4X has no locale-specific grapheme data, and a comment says so. The isWordLike lookup scans the whole boundary list for every segment, so iterating a long string is quadratic. That costs speed but not correctness. test262 shows 158/158 passing with 0 regressions.
